svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 383 mm of 25 x 2 mm tube; square and deburr both ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark one end as the pole end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 4.6 mm straight through, top to bottom, 12.5 mm from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the pole end (the flange cross bolt).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 4.6 mm straight through, in the same plane, 12.5 mm from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the far end (the head cross bolt).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill both holes on a drill press with the tube in a V-block so

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each hole passes through the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the pole end goes 25 mm into the tube flange's socket, the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: far end 25 mm into the head's socket; one bolt through each.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: both holes line up when you sight along the tube.
